about: compiler/testplan: finite domain enumeration, value ranks, constructor display, canonical key scalars, and case plans.

mutants.name: selfhost-testplan-domain-typecap-overflow
mutants.rule: TypeCap caps finite domain enumeration at 256 values so 257-value domains are sampled instead.

mutants.name: selfhost-testplan-domain-ctor-not-listed
mutants.rule: Constructor-backed named types are sampled rather than enumerated as finite domains.

mutants.name: selfhost-testplan-encoding-duration-scalar
mutants.rule: Duration basic kind maps to ScalarInt for canonical state key encoding.

mutants.name: selfhost-testplan-plan-ties-skip-provider
mutants.rule: WithTies never binds ties onto provider inputs.

mutants.name: selfhost-testplan-domain-byctor-op-field
mutants.rule: ByConstructor inspects the root type's own fields rather than assuming a constructor-backed root prints structurally.
